props.name: handle
props.description: Show the drag-handle pill at the top of the sheet.

props.name: items
props.description: Items to render — flat array, grouped (array of arrays), or string/number primitives.

props.name: labelKey
props.description: When `items` are objects, which field to use as the label.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Controlled value. Bind with `v-model`. Array when `multiple` is true.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow selecting more than one item.

props.name: name
props.description: Form submission name. Forwarded to the core `ComboboxRoot`.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Trigger placeholder when no value is selected. Also used as the sheet title.

props.name: presentation
searchable
props.description: Render the in-sheet search input (`true` by default).

props.name: searchIcon
props.description: Iconify name shown in the in-sheet search input. Defaults to `appConfig.ui.icons.search`.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder text inside the in-sheet search input.

props.name: selectedIcon
props.description: Iconify name shown next to selected items. Defaults to `appConfig.ui.icons.check`.

props.name: side
props.description: Edge the picker sheet slides and drags from.

props.name: snapPoints
props.description:
Snap fractions forwarded to `SheetRoot`. Default `[0.9]` matches a
native search-picker — near-full height so the keyboard has room above
the search input.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Iconify name on the trailing side. Defaults to `appConfig.ui.icons.chevronDown`.

props.name: valueKey
props.description: When `items` are objects, which field to use as the value.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Trigger value render override. Defaults to label of the selected item(s).

slots.name: leading
slots.description: Receives `iconColor` so custom icons can match the trigger's resolved theme color.

slots.name: trailing
slots.description: Receives `iconColor` so custom icons can match the trigger's resolved theme color.

slots.name: item
slots.type: { item: string | number | ComboboxItem; index: number; }

slots.name: item-leading
slots.type: { item: string | number | ComboboxItem; index: number; }

slots.name: item-label
slots.type: { item: string | number | ComboboxItem; index: number; }

slots.name: item-trailing
slots.type: { item: string | number | ComboboxItem; index: number; }
